schema.provisioning: Exact PHP-owned manufacturing planning definitions were provisioned only in the throwaway database.

evidence: A tagged finished-good demand and on-hand payload with confirmWrites=false returned dry-run-validated with writes=0 and writesBlocked=true.
The PHP-authoritative dry-run envelope reported phpAuthoritative=true and no planned rows were created.
A confirmed request with an empty demand object returned validation_code=invalid, At least one demand item is required, and writes=0.
A tagged two-level BOM run netted demand 10 against finished-good on-hand 2 and component on-hand 3.
SQL readback showed 8.000 production units at level 0 and 13.000 purchase units at level 1, both status planned, with the submitted due date.
Firming a planned order returned the expected redirect and changed its status to firmed.
Re-running the same MRP payload deleted and recreated the MRP rows; the retry is replacement semantics, not idempotency, and resets status to planned.
Authenticated browser readback rendered Planned orders 2 and the tagged purchase/production rows with quantities, levels, due date, status, and Firm actions.
Tagged planned orders, BOM lines, BOM header, and inventory items were removed from the throwaway database.
SQL verification returned zero remaining tagged planning rows and items.
